question: How can I create a card for CIMB-Mastercard?
ground_truth: To create a card for CIMB-Mastercard, you can use a POST request to https://card-connectors.staging.aspireapp.com/cards/create with the provider set to 'mastercard' and include details like card_holder_name, transaction_limit, and spend_limits.
